title: Hazard
description: A dangerous condition in a zone. The simulator owns hazard evolution (the ground truth); the agent never reads hazards directly and only infers them from signals. Hazards propagate along the zone graph edges with the delay defined on zones.

type.description: Hazard type (flood, wildfire, blackout). The core system treats it as an opaque label; only the scenario pack knows its dynamics.

zone.description: Zone id where the hazard is active.

severity.description: Intensity 0-10. Upstream severity predicts downstream severity after the propagation delay; connecting those dots early is the core system skill.

trend.description: Direction of change. rising upstream is the earliest actionable evidence for downstream zones.

propagating.description: Whether this hazard travels along the zone graph. A flood propagates; a local building collapse does not.
